S.FORM: == kakiliman == kazizeng "kamu nu Ing, motorized vehicle" singangan aca tu kikayay a kazizeng, kazizeng "motor vehicle", lunuk a kazizeng "motor vehicle" aca automobile" kazizeng "car" u inzing ku sapisaungay anca matengtenganay a kazizang, atu miida tu icelang nu tademaw anca u icelang nu aadupen caay ku nu kazizeng a kalalecad. 機動車輛(英語:motorized vehicle) (automotive vehicle或automobile)或汽車 , . nilaculan "kazizeng" u kamu nu imin angangan i zazan muculil ku bihelay a kazizeng, pasu silyenaay a kazizeng anca paculil i zazan nu silamalay a akazizeng "silamalay, sasa silamalay a zazan, mahemaway a zazan cacayay a zazan", kanahatu zikuzay tu tusaay a nizateng hatu tungusay nu kazizeng. nitatengaan nu huluc a kazizeng kapah pahamin han palabasu "mikacawan tu kazizeng passenger vehicle" atu miculu'ay tu tuud a kazizeng "u picukaymasan a kazizeng "utility vehicle" tusa ku kasasizuma, " 和貨運 兩大類, nuayawan duduc tu icelang nu miculu'ay atu pasasuma batikal "mahiniay utubay" uzipay a kazizeng "pasu kazizeng, nisekian a utubay, sihakuay a kazizeng atu sapilabim a kazizeng kahatini, atu labanng tuuday tusaay ku picukaymas nu pi-ka-ciw "labang a kazizeng "duduc ku sapicukaymas u basu labang kazizeng, yulansya atu tanayu'ay ku piculil nu labang a kizizeng, atu taylin a kazizeng, paisingay a kazizeng, mapatayay a kazizeng, zikuzay, a kasasizuma mikelidaay tu tuud a pitupinan tu tuud a kazizeng "tulaku" atu sisimalay a kazizeng, angangan mitengteng tu kazizeng anca a kazize ng nu pawapenay tu kazizeng, micaitay a kazizeng atu mitengtengay, u sapitupin tu lala' kilang a kikay nu misakakawaway a kazizeng "mahiniay micai'tay a kazizeng, micuzuhay tu lalaa' a kazizeng, milacul a kazizeng, mikukutay a kazizeng, mipenecay tu zazan a kazizeng, misaupuay a kazizeng", atu mipadengan tu lamal a kazizeng, mibasbasay tu nanum a kazizeng, tatuni' a kazizengan hatini mikawaway tu kapulunga a kazizeng. sinilacul tu baketay a sapilais a sazikec sapicukaymas nu hitay a kazizeng pulung a ngangan lepacaw a kazizeng. saayaway a icelang nu kazizeng namakayzaay i lahud, nika makay sakatusa a sakakawawan zikuz angangan namakay labu nu akuti' "simal nu inzing anca simal a inzing" anca tengtengay nu dingkiay utubay, micumud tu 21 se-ci zikuz malingatu mangaleb u malalamel ku icelang atu batiliay a icelang. kazizeng a kalamkam atu nipabesbes kikatalakawaan ku cayay ku kazizeng, cunus tu baket nu uzip nu kazizeng atu baket ku nitupin, anu caay pihaymaw ku nipaculil a pihaceng ku satebuc, i kitakit a kasa kanatal u kahenulan ku saculil a hulic, u mikedecay tu kalamkam nu kazizeng atu miduduc tu nitelekan a lihalay ku kazizeng, mabatelu ku kazizeng caay kalecad tu cayay ku kazizeng atu miculilay i zazan tademaw hamin caay kalecad ku icelang a situngu atu bacuen a salikec . paculilay tu kazizeng amilakuit tu nipatucek nu mikuwana tu saculilan miseking pakala tu minkiw amalepun sibangngu ku kazizeng misinsi kya kapah paculil i zazan, nika zuma mahaymaway ku culil tu ahemaway a kazizeng "mahiniay dingkiay a utubay, dingkiay miculil atu utubayay a batikal" zuma a kakitizaan hakay mapala caay ku kazizeng, , nika zuma a kakitizaan atu malecad a kazizeng kanca amiawas tu pikinsa amiala tu minkiw nu sapaculil paninaku dingkiay a batikal i Cow-kow-talu u Cong-hwa-ze-min-kung-he-kow u paketun nu hulic u cayay a kazizeng, nika i Syang-kangn nu micidekay a kitizaan Syang-kang a hulic palakazizengen, amisinsi tu minkiw nu sapaculil tu dingkiay utubay. . malalitin tu i hekalan atu zumaay a natinengay
